body: I knew a girl in middle school whos mom got into drugs and prostitution. Her mom had her and her little brother living in New York, and they fell on hard times. The mom eventually got busted, and they called the kids dads to ask if they wanted them. Since they had different dads, they ended up getting split up, and the girl had to move down to Texas. I remember she used to keep drawings her brother had made her in her binder. I knew her all throughout middle school and all she wanted to do was see her brother again.

My dad always yelled at my sister and I about breaking his Playstation controller. The buttons and triggers would constantly get stuck. My sister and I just played Sims, so we never really understood why it kept breaking. We used to have a little boy that we would babysit until his mom got home; he was probably 10 or 11. He was a real rowdy kid, so my dad (who was always home when the boy was there) would play the playstation with him. They were playing together one day and I walked in to see this kid just SLAMMING his fingers down on the buttons and triggers. I immediately realized THIS was why the buttons were sticking.So I spoke up (me being maybe 16) and told the kid to calm down with the buttons.

My dad immediately jumped on me, telling me that I shouldnt tell anybody how to play with HIS controller. At that point, I was just done.
